annotations.title: Put a picture on my page

description: Put a picture on the coach's public page, as the Public page tab's picture buttons do: kind portrait (their face, shown round), cover (the wide picture across the top, also what a shared link shows) or gallery (up to 9, each with a caption). A new portrait or cover replaces the old one. Give image_url when the picture is already online (their website, a public link): TriPeak fetches it. A photo attached in this chat cannot be handed over: never retype one as base64, it is slow and breaks. Send the coach to the page editor instead, editor_link below, where the picture buttons upload it in a second. image_base64 is only for a client that holds the file's bytes itself. JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

image_base64.description: Only when you hold the file itself: the bytes, base64. Never a retyped copy of a chat attachment.

image_url.description: An https address of the picture, reachable without signing in

name: upload_page_image
